definitions: In a difficult situation where one must choose between two equally undesirable options.
Caught in a dilemma with no easy solution.
examples: She was between a rock and a hard place, needing to either sell her house or declare bankruptcy.
The company found itself between a rock and a hard place, facing rising costs and declining sales.
He felt between a rock and a hard place, having to choose between disappointing his parents or his girlfriend.
lemma: between a rock and a hard place
synonyms: on the horns of a dilemma
source: between a rock and a hard place
